calculation_policy: No local min/max/mean/max-min recomputation. Only official DEM/LIDAR source evidence may be accepted after BUILDING_PRESENT parcel binding.
first_missing_criterion: BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel identifiers/geometries (or explicit missing DEM/LIDAR tile ids/bboxes) from local OpenCode
next_modified_method: Receive the local BUILDING_PRESENT missing-tile selector, then query only the intersecting Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme/DTM index features (<=50) and retain dtm_fn, tilename, polygon_id, EPSG:27700, resolution, sd_flown/ed_flown/year and access evidence; do not recompute parcel height statistics remotely.

source_window.description_evidence: National LIDAR 1m Programme Index Catalogue; each tile exposes National LIDAR Programme DTM metadata including specific survey date and unique survey id.
source_window.public_access_constraints: none; use subject to identified licence
source_window.record_acceptance_reason: The remote producer slot does not contain BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel identifiers/geometries or an explicit missing-tile selector. Arbitrary tiles are therefore not accepted as Height Difference progress.
source_window.tile_alignment: 5km tiles aligned to Ordnance Survey grid
